name: Acolyte
passive: Magic Armor: +2 max Stress. Mana = INT × 10. You may spend Stress as Mana. Kits (both): Acolyte Symbol · Hex Knife. Free Weapon Swap between kits 1/your turn (second swap same turn costs 1 AP).
notes: Symbol: on hit, support extra to ally R5 (Catch Breath / Cleanse). Core: Shove Push 3/4/5 (STR1); Steel CLEANSE 3/4/6 (INT1).
